column3: With respect to the Stadium Lofts Apartments Mortgage Loan (1.7%), the Phase I ESA identified a CREC at the Mortgaged Property. The ESA indicated that the Mortgaged Property is part of the 9.2 acre former K-Town Furniture property which is identified as a Brownfields site that also includes adjacent parcels. Historical operations at the Mortgaged Property and other nearby sites that were included in the Brownfields Property include K-Town Furniture, Fieldcrest Cannon Plant No. 1, Bob’s Laundry, Star Drycleaners, and Wrenn’s Cleaners.
